_what: Set up everything a saved setup list names, in one run. A saved setup list is one row of choices; each choice is {job, definition_id, input}: the job in words, the workflow that does it, and that workflow's own input. This workflow goes through input.choices (in order when input.in_order is true, else all at once) and runs the workflow each choice names with that choice's input; a choice whose workflow asks the person something (an account, a payment, a key) pauses the run there until it is answered. Changing a choice changes which workflow runs; nothing here names a kind of choice. The caller passes these two definitions and the definition of every workflow the choices name to tool:run-workflow-definition.
